sql: SELECT T2.Country FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID WHERE T1.Age > 40 AND T1.Age < 30
SELECT s.Name, s.Country FROM singer s JOIN singer_in_concert si ON s.Singer_ID = si.Singer_ID JOIN concert c ON si.Concert_ID = c.Concert_ID WHERE c.Song_Name LIKE '%Hey%'
SELECT StuID, weight FROM Pets WHERE pet_age > 1
SELECT StuID FROM Has_Pet WHERE PetID IN (SELECT PetID FROM Pets WHERE PetType = 'dog' AND LName = 'Smith')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Has_Pet WHERE StuID IN (SELECT StuID FROM Pets)
SELECT Model FROM cars_data ORDER BY Horsepower ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT Maker FROM car_makers WHERE Id IN (SELECT MakeId FROM cars_data WHERE Year = 1970)
SELECT CountryName FROM countries ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(Weight), YEAR FROM cars_data GROUP BY YEAR
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders > 6
SELECT MAX(MPG) FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 8 AND Year < 1980
SELECT Country FROM airlines WHERE Airline = 'JetBlue Airways'
SELECT Abbreviation FROM airlines WHERE Airline = 'JetBlue Airways'
SELECT Airline FROM airlines WHERE Abbreviation = 'UAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airlines WHERE Country = 'USA'
SELECT T2.AirportName FROM airports AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.City = T2.SourceAirport WHERE T1.City = 'Aberdeen'
SELECT T2.AirportName FROM airports AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.City = T2.SourceAirport WHERE T1.AirportCode = 'ABD'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE DestAirport = 'ATO'
SELECT AirportCode FROM airports GROUP BY AirportCode ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Airline FROM airlines AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.uid = T2.Airline WHERE T2.SourceAirport = 'CVO' AND T2.DestAirport != 'APG'
SELECT count(*) FROM employee
SELECT DISTINCT T2.city FROM employee AS T1 JOIN evaluation AS T2 ON T1.employee_id = T2.employee_id WHERE T1.age > 30 GROUP BY T2.city HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT LOCATION, COUNT(*) FROM shop GROUP BY LOCATION
SELECT Manager_name, District FROM shop ORDER BY Number_products DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT District FROM shop WHERE Number_products < 3000 INTERSECT SELECT District FROM shop WHERE Number_products > 10000
SELECT count(DISTINCT LOCATION) FROM shop
SELECT Document_ID, Template_ID, Document_Description FROM Documents WHERE Document_Name = 'Robbin CV'
SELECT T1.Template_ID, T1.Version_Number, T1.Template_Type_Code FROM Templates AS T1 JOIN Ref_Template_Types AS T2 ON T1.Template_Type_Code = T2.Template_Type_Code
SELECT COUNT(Template_ID) FROM Templates WHERE Template_Type_Code = 'CV'
SELECT Template_Type_Code, Template_Type_Description FROM Templates
SELECT T2.Paragraph_ID, T2.Paragraph_Text FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Paragraphs AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID WHERE T1.Document_Name = 'Welcome to NY'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Document_ID FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Paragraphs AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID GROUP BY T1.Document_ID HAVING COUNT(T2.Paragraph_ID) >= 2
SELECT Document_ID, Document_Name FROM Documents ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Document_ID FROM Documents WHERE Paragraph_ID BETWEEN 1 AND 2
SELECT T2.Name FROM teacher AS T1 JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID = T2.Teacher_ID WHERE T1.Hometown != 'Little Lever Urban District'
SELECT T2.Name FROM teacher AS T1 JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID = T2.Teacher_ID WHERE T1.Age BETWEEN 32 AND 33
SELECT T2.Hometown FROM course AS T1 JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Course_ID = T2.Course_ID JOIN teacher AS T3 ON T2.Teacher_ID = T3.Teacher_ID GROUP BY T2.Hometown HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
SELECT Open_Year, Num_of_Staff FROM museum WHERE Name = 'Plaza Museum'
SELECT SUM(Total_spent) FROM visit WHERE Level_of_membership = 1
SELECT T1.first_name, T1.birth_date FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T1.country_code = 'USA'
SELECT AVG(winner_age) AS avg_winner_age, AVG(loser_age) AS avg_loser_age FROM matches
SELECT ranking_date, COUNT(*) FROM rankings GROUP BY ranking_date
SELECT YEAR(year), COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM matches GROUP BY YEAR(year)
SELECT max(killed) AS max_killed, min(injured) AS min_injured FROM death
SELECT T1.name, T1.result FROM battle AS T1 JOIN death AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.cause_by_ship_id WHERE T1.bulgarian_commander != 'Boril'
SELECT count(*) FROM Courses
SELECT T2.department_name, T2.department_id FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Departments AS T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.department_id GROUP BY T2.department_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT section_name, section_description FROM Sections
SELECT T2.department_description FROM Departments AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.degree_program_id WHERE T1.department_name LIKE '%computer%'
SELECT T2.degree_summary_name FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T2.degree_summary_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_name FROM Student_Enrolment AS T1 JOIN Semesters AS T2 ON T1.semester_id = T2.semester_id WHERE T1.student_id IS NULL
SELECT T1.transcript_date, T1.student_course_id FROM Transcript_Contents AS T1 JOIN Transcripts AS T2 ON T1.transcript_id = T2.transcript_id GROUP BY T1.transcript_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
SELECT address_id, line_1, line_2 FROM Addresses GROUP BY address_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT section_name FROM Sections WHERE section_id = 1
SELECT * FROM Cartoon WHERE Directed_by = 'Ben Jones'
SELECT Title FROM Cartoon WHERE Directed_by = 'Ben Jones'
SELECT T2.series_name FROM Cartoon AS T1 JOIN TV_Channel AS T2 ON T1.Channel = T2.id WHERE T1.Title = 'The Rise of the Blue Beetle!'
SELECT Episode, Rating FROM TV_series ORDER BY Rating DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT min(Share) ,  max(Share) FROM TV_series
SELECT T2.Series_name FROM TV_series AS T1 JOIN TV_channel AS T2 ON T1.Channel = T2.id WHERE T1.Episode = 'A Love of a Lifetime'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poker_player
SELECT Name FROM poker_player WHERE Earnings > 300000
SELECT Nationality, COUNT(*) FROM people GROUP BY Nationality
SELECT Name FROM people WHERE Nationality != 'Russia'
SELECT count(DISTINCT Nationality) FROM people
SELECT vote_id, phone_number, state FROM VOTES
SELECT COUNT(contestant_number) FROM VOTES WHERE state NOT IN (SELECT state FROM AREA_CODE_STATE)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE GovernmentForm = 'Republic'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS PeopleInAsia, MAX(GNP) AS LargestGNP FROM city WHERE CountryCode = 'Asia'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Language = 'Aruba' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Name = 'Aruba'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Code) FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language = 'English' AND T2.Language = 'Dutch'
SELECT T1.Language FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Continent = 'Asia' GROUP BY T1.Language ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.GovernmentForm, SUM(T2.Population) AS TotalPopulation
FROM country AS T1
JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode
WHERE T1.LifeExpectancy > 72
GROUP BY T1.GovernmentForm
SELECT Language FROM countrylanguage ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM conductor
SELECT Name FROM conductor ORDER BY Age ASC
SELECT Name FROM conductor WHERE Nationality != "USA"
SELECT T2.name, T2.grade FROM Highschooler AS T1 JOIN Likes AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.student_id
SELECT ID FROM Highschooler WHERE name = 'Kyle'
SELECT grade FROM Highschooler GROUP BY grade HAVING COUNT(student_id) >= 4
SELECT h.name, COUNT(l.student_id) FROM Highschooler h JOIN Likes l ON h.id = l.highest_schooler_id GROUP BY h.name
SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.friend_id = T2.ID GROUP BY T2.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Likes AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.friend_id = (SELECT ID FROM Highschooler WHERE name = 'Kyle')
SELECT COUNT(student_id) FROM Friend WHERE student_id = (SELECT student_id FROM Highschooler WHERE name = 'Kyle')
SELECT student_id FROM Friend WHERE friend_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM Likes)

SELECT h.name, COUNT(l.liked_id) AS num_likes
FROM Highschooler h
JOIN Likes l ON h.ID = l.student_id
GROUP BY h.name
SELECT T1.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Likes AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.liked_id IS NOT NULL AND T1.grade > 5 AND COUNT(T1.friend_id) >= 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Likes WHERE student_id = (SELECT student_id FROM Friend WHERE name = 'Kyle')
SELECT T2.name FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Owners AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id WHERE T1.date_adopted > DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1000 DAY)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Owners AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id WHERE T1.first_name NOT IN (SELECT T2.first_name FROM Owners AS T2)

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id WHERE T1.first_name NOT IN (SELECT T2.first_name FROM Dogs AS T2 WHERE T2.name NOT IN (SELECT T1.first_name FROM Owners AS T1))

SELECT T2.professional_id, T2.role_code, T2.email_address FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Professional AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Adelle' AND T1.last_name = 'DuBuque' AND T1.state = 'NorthDakota' AND T1.zip_code = '00589'

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id JOIN Professional AS T3 ON T2.professional_id = T3.professional_id WHERE T2.cost_of_treatment < (SELECT AVG(cost_of_treatment) FROM Treatments)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Treatments WHERE dog_id IN (SELECT dog_id FROM Dogs WHERE abandoned_yn = 1)
SELECT T1.name, T1.age, T1.weight FROM Dogs AS T1 INNER JOIN Abandoned_Dogs AS T2 ON T1.dog_id = T2.dog_id WHERE T2.abandoned_yn = 1
SELECT AVG(age) FROM Dogs
SELECT MAX(charge_amount) FROM Charges
SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Birth_Year = 1948 OR Birth_Year = 1949
SELECT Citizenship, COUNT(*) FROM singer GROUP BY Citizenship
SELECT property_type_description FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code = 'Apartment'
